results.title: Infantino Gets Backing From Six Arab Federations Amid FIFA Revolt
results.description: Kashmir, Observer, Jammu, Srinagar, Latest Kashmir News, Kashmir News, Kashmir Latest News The heads of six Arab soccer federations expressed their “full support” and “confidence” in Gianni Infantino on Thursday as the embattled FIFA president fights to keep his job after his failed World Cup private investment plan. The post Infantino Gets Backing From Six Arab Federations Amid FIFA Revolt appeared first on Kashmir Observer .
